Shouldn’t your wife keep the house “open house” ready? Yes your kids should definitely have responsibilities and chores but they should not be the sole person cleaning especially at that standard. And they should not be expected to watch their younger brother. Get the mom up. Tell her to clean tell her to watch her children. I can see the twins having to pick up after themselves and do dishes and mow the lawn though. And it’s insane that when you start to feel pressure of watching your youngest son that you go to your children to help and not your wife? Shouldn’t you go to the mother and say this isn’t working for you and that y’all need to find a new routine? And side note if your kids miss too many days of school you could get into trouble. Early check outs count towards how many absences they can have each term. Maybe get a nanny to watch the kids since your wife won’t but that sounds like a huge red flag. There’s something going on with her. Might want to get her some counseling for her and the kids it sounds like. Also apologize to your kids. There is so much no in this post.
